answer: Yes, you can withdraw after the census date until the last day to withdraw from units, but you will not get a refund. The unit is recorded as WD-LATE (shown as WDN, not a fail grade) or as WD-FAIL (a WN fail grade), and the passages do not say which code applies to you.
